body.en: Communication is the transfer of information and understanding from one person to another. In business it links people, departments and the firm with customers, suppliers and the public. The *process* has these elements: a sender has an idea and encodes it into words, symbols or gestures; the message travels through a channel or medium (a meeting, phone, letter, e-mail); the receiver decodes it to find its meaning; and feedback tells the sender whether the message was understood. Noise is anything that disturbs the process at any stage.

points.en: Sender → encoding → message → channel → decoding → receiver → feedback
Noise can distort the message at any stage

body.en: Formal *communication* follows the official chain of command and is usually recorded: orders, reports, circulars. It may flow downward (superior to subordinate), upward (subordinate to superior) or horizontally (between equals in different departments). Informal communication, often called the grapevine, arises from social relations; it is fast but may carry rumours. By medium, communication may be oral (face to face, phone, meetings), written (letters, reports, e-mail) or non-verbal (gestures, facial expression, posture, tone).

points.en: Informal: grapevine; quick but may spread rumours

problem.en: Classify each: (a) the sales manager sends a monthly target circular to salesmen; (b) a worker submits a suggestion to the supervisor; (c) the purchase and production heads discuss stock levels; (d) news of a bonus spreads in the canteen before it is announced.

narration.en: Let us work this out step by step. say.en: Let us work this out step by step. Classify each: a the sales manager sends a monthly target circular to salesmen; b a worker submits a suggestion to the supervisor; c the purchase and production heads discuss stock levels; d news of a bonus spreads in the canteen before it is announced.
a Formal, downward communication.
b Formal, upward communication.
c Formal, horizontal lateral communication.
d Informal communication: the grapevine.
So the answer is Downward, upward, horizontal and grapevine.
